systems.platform: rdcpass.gouv.cd, with the agent terminal agent.rdcpass.cd and the citizen account app.rdcpass.cd
systems.owner: Programme national d'identifiant numérique, République Démocratique du Congo
systems.tiers: platform online; phase 1 agent training under way, citizen enrolment at official reception points to open a week after agents are certified; Kinshasa named as the first node, registration points not yet announced

note: The RDCpass platform's own page: verified digital identity, e-signature, document verification and access to services. It says nothing of civil registration, births or deaths.
